bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Bears (6-2) are preparing to host the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in a Sunday Night Football showdown at Soldier Field, seeking their fourth straight win and sixth victory in their last seven games , with the team getting encouraging injury news as running back Kyle Monangai returned to practice on a limited basis Friday for the first time since injuring his toe and thumb in a Week 4 win over the Jets . The bigger storyline remains the team's trade deadline activity after acquiring All-Pro defensive lineman Jeffery Simmons from Tennessee, with the Bears also receiving a 2028 fifth-round selection , while continuing to shuffle the roster by placing Kentavius Street on injured reserve ahead of the Buccaneers matchup.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions placed linebacker Jack Campbell on injured reserve after he suffered a neck injury, while signing cornerback Nick Whiteside to the active roster and elevating running back Jabari Small and defensive end Anthony Lucas from the practice squad ahead of their Week 9 game against the Miami Dolphins. packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers elevated tight end Drake Dabney from the practice squad to the active roster on Saturday ahead of their Week 9 road game against the New England Patriots, filling in for Josh Whyle, who was ruled out due to a concussion. The Packers opted against activating running back Chris Brooks from injured reserve or elevating additional cornerbacks, a sign that Keisean Nixon is expected to be available for the contest.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Minnesota Vikings (6-1) are set to start Carson Wentz at quarterback for Monday Night Football against the Buffalo Bills (6-1) after Kevin O'Connell confirmed Kyler Murray will miss the game with a hamstring strain he's considered week-to-week. Kyler Murray will be sidelined for the Vikings Monday Night Football game with a hamstring strain, Head Coach Kevin O'Connell said Thursday, with Max Brosmer serving as Minnesota's backup quarterback.
